title: SDET
description:
### **FinBox: Where Fintech Meets Fun!**

Welcome to FinBox, the buzzing hive of tech innovation and creativity!

Since our inception in 2017, FinBox has built some of the most advanced technologies in the financial services space that help lenders like Banks, NBFCs and large enterprises build and launch credit products within a matter of days, not months or years. FinBox is a Series B funded company which is expanding globally with offices in India, Vietnam, Indonesia and Philippines.

Our vision is to build the best-in-class infrastructure for lending products and help Banks & Financial Services companies across the world scale and launch credit programs that set a new standard in the era of digital finance. So far, we’ve helped our customers disburse Billions of Dollars in credit across unsecured and secured credit including personal loans, working capital loans, business loans, mortgage and education loans. FinBox solutions are already being used by over 100+ companies to deliver credit to over 5 million customers every month.

### **Why Should You be a FinBoxer:**

* **Innovative Environment:** At FinBox, we foster a culture of creativity and experimentation, encouraging our team to push the boundaries of what's possible in fintech.
* **Impactful Work:** Your contributions will directly impact the lives of millions, helping to provide fair and accessible credit to individuals and businesses alike.
* **Growth Opportunities:** We are a Series B funded startup and have ample opportunities for growth, professional development and career advancement.
* **Collaborative Culture:** Join a diverse and inclusive team of experts who are passionate about making a difference and supporting one another.

### **Who’s a Great FinBoxer:**

At FinBox, we’re on the lookout for exceptional folks who are all about innovation and impact. If you’re excited to shake things up in the banking & financial services world, keep reading!

**Creative Thinkers:** If your brain is always bubbling with out-of-the-box ideas and wild solutions, you’re our kind of person. We love disruptors who challenge the norm and bring fresh perspectives to the table.

**Customer Heroes:** Our customers are our champions, and we need heroes who can understand their needs, deliver magical experiences, and go above and beyond to keep them happy.

**Team Players:** We believe in the power of “we.” If you thrive in a collaborative environment, value different viewpoints, and enjoy being part of a spirited, supportive team, you’ll fit right in.

### **About the Role**

We’re looking for a hands-on SDET to build and scale our test automation framework, improve coverage across critical lending workflows, and strengthen release quality. You’ll work closely with developers, Product Managers and TPMs in a fast-paced environment. This is a **build-from-scratch mindset** role focused on automation engineering, not just test execution.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Build and enhance reusable test automation frameworks and utilities.
* Automate functional, API, UI and end-to-end tests for critical lending workflows and BankConnect.
* Perform mobile, web and SDK testing to validate functionality, integration, compatibility and reliability across mobile platforms and client applications.
* Own test strategy, regression coverage and release-quality assessment for your product pod.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and investigate failures.
* Collaborate with engineering and product teams to identify risks early and prevent production defects.
* Use AI-assisted tools and explore agentic testing to improve automation efficiency.
* Conduct performance and load testing of services and SDKs when required, and help establish performance SLAs.

### **What We’re Looking For**

* B.E./B.Tech in any engineering discipline.
* 2 - 3 years of hands-on SDET or test automation experience.
* Experience building or extending automation frameworks, not just maintaining existing tests.
* Proficiency in Java, Python or Go.
* Hands-on experience with at least **two** of the following:  
  **Test Automation Frameworks:** TestNG, pytest, or equivalent frameworks.  
  **Web UI Automation:** Selenium or Playwright.  
  **Mobile UI Automation:** Appium or Detox.  
  **API Automation:** RestAssured or native API testing libraries.
* Understanding of mobile application, web, SDK and API testing.
* Strong debugging skills and the ability to navigate unfamiliar codebases.
* Familiarity with CI/CD fundamentals.
* A builder mindset, ownership and the ability to deliver independently.

### **Good to Have**

* Fintech, lending or multi-tenant SaaS experience.
* Exposure to AWS, Docker or Kubernetes.
* Performance testing using k6 or Locust.
* Experience with AI coding assistants or AI-driven testing.
* Utilisation of AI tools to accelerate test automation through agentic workflows.

title: SDET 3 - Model Evaluation
description:
**About AiDASH**  
  
AiDASH is leading the PreventionFirst™movement for electric utilities and transforming grid resilience through its pioneering platform that unifies vegetation, asset, storm, and wildfire intelligence. Powered by SatelliteFirst™ Inspection & Monitoring, AiDASH delivers comprehensive visibility across the entire grid at the right frequency and budget, using the right data modality. More than 200 customers trust AiDASH to keep the lights on, spend where it counts, and defend every decision, Securing Tomorrow across every mile of the grid. Learn more at www.aidash.com.

The PreventionFirst movement is growing, and so is the recognition behind it. In 2026, Forbes named AiDASH one of America's Best Startup Employers for the 4th consecutive year, and TIME included AiDASH among America's Top GreenTech Companies for the 3rd year in a row. Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ ranked AiDASH No. 12 in the San Francisco Bay Area, and No. 59 overall in their selection of the top 500 for 2024.

Join us in Securing Tomorrow Together!

#### **The Role**

The Platform ML team deploys and validates every ML model behind Aidash's products. These models process satellite imagery, geospatial data, and weather data. As an SDET-3, you will own end-to-end quality for these models, from training data preparation through inference pipelines to performance at production scale. You will validate both functional correctness and scaling behavior, and you will use agentic AI tools to move faster without lowering engineering standards.

**How You'll Make an Impact:**

* **Own model quality before production.** Build validation frameworks for computer vision models (preferably satellite or geospatial). Catch regressions in accuracy, precision/recall, and IoU before they reach customers.

* **Build version-aware model regression.** Set up pipelines that compare inference outputs across model versions on curated golden datasets. Every release should come with a clear, data-backed go/no-go signal.

* **Make data quality a first-class gate.** Validate training and evaluation datasets for label quality, class balance, geographic and seasonal coverage, leakage, and drift. Ensure models are tested on data that reflects real-world conditions.

* **Validate inference at scale.** Design load and benchmark tests for inference services and batch pipelines. Find the throughput, latency, and cost limits on AWS and Kubernetes before customers do.

* **Harden the platform end-to-end.** Automate API, contract, and data-pipeline tests across distributed services. Use logs, metrics, and traces to speed up root-cause analysis.

* **Raise the bar for the team.** Strengthen the shared automation frameworks and set standards for maintainable, non-flaky tests. Show how tools like Cursor and Claude can speed up test authoring, triage, and reporting while staying under human review.

* **Influence release decisions.** This is a high-visibility role. Your quality signals will directly shape what ships across Aidash's product lines

  

**What** **we're** **looking for:**

We are looking for a senior QA engineer with deep backend automation experience who can validate ML models and backend systems end-to-end, and who actively uses agentic AI development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) to accelerate test design, automation, debugging, and reporting — without compromising fundamentals, coverage, or engineering quality.

* 8–10 years in software testing and test automation, with strong ownership of backend system quality

* Hands-on backend automation experience using at least one of:

* Java + RestAssured Or Python + pytest

* Experience testing ML applications (model/service behavior, data quality, inference pipelines, evaluation/regression of model-backed features)

* Broader stack familiarity: observability (logs/metrics/traces), cloud (AWS), contract testing, data-pipeline validation

* Experience improving shared automation frameworks and raising team standards for maintainable tests

* Solid grasp of testing fundamentals and best practices (test design, risk-based coverage, isolation, maintainability, flaky-test control, clear defect/RCA discipline)

* Strong coding ability in Java or Python (proficient in at least one), with willingness to learn the other (or additional languages) as needed

* Good understanding of backend system design and how services interact in distributed systems

* Practical exposure to databases — SQL and/or NoSQL (at least one is mandatory)

* Working knowledge of application deployment and underlying orchestration (e.g., containers, Kubernetes, service rollout/health concepts)

* CI/CD pipelines — must have (Jenkins/GitHub Actions/Bitbucket Pipelines or equivalent): triggering suites, reading failures, improving pipeline reliability

* Performance testing — must have (JMeter/k6/Locust or equivalent): load/benchmark basics, interpreting results, flagging SLA/risk

* Exposure to agentic development tools such as Cursor and Claude (or similar) for coding, test authoring, log/triage assistance, and documentation — used with human review and quality gates

We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to embracing diversity and inclusion in our hiring practices, and we promote a work environment where everyone, from any race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin, can do their best work.

We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all candidates. Please let us know if you require any accommodation during the interview process, and we will make every effort to meet your needs.  
  
Read our Privacy Policy here: https://www.aidash.com/policy/privacy-policy/

title: Senior Enterprise Automation Engineer
description:
**Who are we?**
===============

At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a **Senior Enterprise Automation Engineer** to help transform how Enterprise IT delivers services through automation, AI, and intelligent self-service.

This role will serve as the primary implementation partner for Enterprise IT AI initiatives, working closely with the AI Center of Excellence (AI-COE), service owners, and subject matter experts to operationalize Microsoft Copilot, develop AI-powered agents, and automate end-to-end business and IT workflows.

  

The successful candidate will play a key role in driving a **Bot First** service model, where employees interact with intelligent agents and automated workflows before engaging traditional support channels. The focus is on improving employee experience, increasing operational efficiency, and reducing manual effort across Enterprise IT services

* Promote best practices for AI, automation, and self-service adoption.
Act as a trusted advisor on automation and AI capabilities.  

  

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Experience integrating enterprise applications and services using APIs and workflow automation.
* Strong understanding of IT service delivery and service management processes.
* Ability to work effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and subject matter experts.

**Preferred**

Experience with AI governance, prompt engineering, or responsible AI practices.  

**What Success Looks Like**

In your first year, you will:

* Improve knowledge readiness and AI effectiveness.
* Reduce manual fulfillment effort through intelligent automation.
* Establish yourself as a trusted technology partner for AI-COE and Enterprise IT teams.
* Help shape the future of AI-driven service delivery within the organization.

We are proud to offer a range of incentives to our employees worldwide. These benefits are available to everyone, regardless of grade, and reflect the values we stand for:

**Flexibility:** Enjoy unlimited vacation, subject to local regulations and business priorities. Benefit from hybrid working arrangements and inclusive policies such as paid time off for voting, bereavement, and sick leave.

**Well‑being:** Access confidential one‑to‑one support through our Employee Assistance Program, connect with our network of Wellbeing Champions and Gather Groups, and take part in monthly events and initiatives designed to help you thrive—inside and outside of work.

**Health & Financial Security:** Medical, life and disability insurance, retirement plans, lifestyle, and other benefits.\*

**Inclusion:** Get involved in our inclusion communities, such as Count Me In, Culture@Finastra, Proud@Finastra, Disabilities@Finastra, and Women@Finastra—open to everyone who wants to participate and contribute.

**Career Development:** Access online learning and accredited courses through our Skills & Career Navigator tool.

At Finastra, each individual is unique—bringing their own ideas, perspectives, cultural backgrounds, and experiences. We learn from one another, value what makes us different, and create an environment where everyone feels included, supported, and able to be their authentic selves.

Be unique. Be exceptional. Help us make a difference at Finastra.

title: SASE Firewall QA Automation Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**

NETGEAR is looking for a QA Automation Engineer to help validate our next-generation firewall and cybersecurity platform. In this role, you will build and maintain automated tests that verify firewall behavior across critical security domains including Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW), Secure Access Service Edge (SASE), Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Secure Web Gateways (SWG), Virtual Private Networks (VPN), and Software-Defined Wide Area Networks (SD-WAN).

Working alongside firewall developers and senior QA engineers, you will automate functional, regression, and performance testing against real and simulated network traffic. You will not be expected to know every area of the stack on day one — we will support you in growing across it.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and maintain automated test suites that validate firewall functionality — policy and rule evaluation, NAT, stateful session handling, and traffic filtering across NGFW, SASE, ZTNA, SWG, VPN, and SD-WAN features.
* Build and maintain test topologies and lab environments, including virtual machines, containers, and physical firewall appliances.
* Generate and shape realistic network traffic to exercise the firewall data plane, and verify observed behavior against expected policy outcomes.
* Run test suites in CI, triage failures, distinguish product defects from environment and test issues, and file clear, reproducible defect reports with supporting packet captures and logs.
* Contribute to test plans and test-case design from firewall requirements, and help keep automation coverage mapped to those test cases.
* Support performance and scale testing — throughput, connections per second, and concurrent sessions — and help identify regressions.
* Work with developers to improve testability, and stay current with automation tooling, including AI-assisted test generation, maintenance, and failure triage.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 2–4 years of professional experience in QA automation or test engineering, preferably for networking or security products.
* Strong automation scripting ability in Python and Bash, comfort working in Ubuntu or other Linux environments from the command line, and day-to-day use of Git.
* Working knowledge of networking protocols and traffic flows — TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS/SSL, NAT, and routing fundamentals.
* Understanding of firewall fundamentals such as packet filtering, stateful connection tracking, NAT, and rule and policy evaluation.
* Hands-on experience with Linux networking and firewall tooling — iptables and nftables rule configuration, conntrack for session inspection, and iproute2 (ip addr, ip route, network namespaces, bridges, VLANs) for building and inspecting test topologies.
* Proficient in analyzing logs and network captures using tools such as Wireshark, tshark, and tcpdump.
* Experience with a test framework and runner such as pytest or Robot Framework.
* Experience with REST API testing using Postman, REST Assured, or scripted HTTP clients, for validating firewall management and policy APIs.
* Experience running automated tests in CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
* Familiarity with defect tracking and test management tools (e.g., Jira, TestRail, Xray), and good communication skills in an agile, cross-functional team.

**Preferred Qualifications (optional):**

* Experience with traffic generation, shaping, and impairment tools such as iperf3, Scapy, hping3, tc/netem, TRex, or commercial testers like Spirent or Ixia.
* Contributions to open-source security or networking projects.
* Exposure to firewall security testing — IPS/IDS signature validation, TLS/SSL inspection, URL filtering, and threat-feed verification.
* Familiarity with virtualization and container tooling for building test labs — Docker and Docker Compose, VMware or KVM, Kubernetes — and with infrastructure-as-code such as Ansible or Terraform.
* Exposure to performance and scale testing, and to high-availability and failover validation.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted and agentic testing tools — for example LLM-assisted test generation, self-healing test maintenance, or agent-based exploratory testing — and an interest in applying them to network security test suites.
* Experience automating network devices and appliances over SSH and CLI using libraries such as Paramiko or Netmiko.
* Familiarity with certificate and PKI tooling such as OpenSSL, for generating test certificates and validating TLS/SSL inspection behavior.
* Experience validating firewall logging and telemetry — syslog, NetFlow, or IPFIX export — against expected policy events.

**Company Statement/Values:**

At NETGEAR, we are on a mission to unleash the full potential of connectivity with intelligent solutions that delight and protect. We turn ideas into innovative networking products that connect people, power businesses, and advance the way we live.

We're a performance-driven, talented and connected team that's committed to delivering world-class products for our customers. As a company, we value our employees as the most essential building blocks of our success. And as teammates, we commit to taking our work to the *Next Gear* by living our values: we **Dare to Transform** the future, **Connect and Delight** our customers, **Communicate Courageously** with each other and collaborate to **Win It Together**. You’ll find our values woven through our processes, present in our decisions, and celebrated throughout our culture.

We strive to attract top talent and create a great workplace where people feel engaged, inspired, challenged, proud and respected. If you are creative, forward-thinking, passionate about technology and are looking for a rewarding career to make an impact, then you've got what it takes to succeed at NETGEAR. Join our network and help us shape the future of connectivity.

*NETGEAR hires based on merit. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.*

title: AI Automation Engineer
description:
AI Automation Engineer

. 5 9 years of experience AI Automation Engineer or similar role.

Role summaryBuild, deploy, and support AI agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio that replace manual work and automate business processes. Work directly with the AI Architect and business teams to turn process pain points into working agents, then track adoption and impact.  
  
Key responsibilities  
  
1. Requirements discovery: Work with the AI Architect and business users to understand manual workflows, identify automation candidates, and define agent scope and success criteria.  
2. Agent development: Build agents in Copilot Studio, including topics, prompts, knowledge sources, actions, and conversation flows.  
3. Workflow automation: Connect agents to systems using Power Automate, connectors, and APIs (e.g., SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, Dataverse, Excel, ServiceNow, internal apps).  
4. Prompt and knowledge design: Write and refine instructions, ground agents on enterprise content, and tune responses for accuracy and consistency.  
5. Testing and quality: Test agents for accuracy, edge cases, and failure handling. Validate with business users before release.  
6. Deployment and governance: Follow architect defined standards for security, data access, DLP, environment management (dev/test/prod), and responsible AI.  
7. Usage tracking and reporting: Monitor agent adoption, volume, resolution rates, and time/effort saved. Build simple dashboards (Power BI or Copilot Studio analytics) and report progress to leadership.  
8. Continuous improvement: Review feedback and usage data, then iterate on agents to improve performance and expand coverage.  
9. Documentation and enablement: Maintain agent documentation, runbooks, and user guides. Train business users on adoption.  
  
  
Required qualifications  
  
1. 3+ years in automation, software, or solutions engineering  
2. Hands on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse)  
3. Working knowledge of generative AI concepts: LLMs, prompt engineering, grounding/RAG, and agent limitations  
4. Experience with REST APIs, JSON, and system integrations  
5. Ability to translate business processes into automated workflows  
6. Strong communication skills and comfort working directly with non technical stakeholders  
  
  
Preferred qualifications  
  
1. Microsoft certifications (PL 200, PL 400, AI 900, AI 102)  
2. Experience with Azure AI services (Azure OpenAI, AI Foundry, AI Search)  
3. Familiarity with agent frameworks beyond Copilot Studio  
4. Basic Python or JavaScript for custom actions  
5. Power BI for usage and ROI reporting

title: Senior Manager - Engineering Excellence
description:
**We create possibilities that move life and commerce forward**
Welcome to Manhattan. Every day, our supply chain commerce technology connects two billion people to 20 billion consumer choices. In the warehouse, on the road and in the store, we make what was once impossible, possible. If you want to tackle complex problems and redefine markets, you’ve come to the right place.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and evolve the enterprise Test Automation and Quality Engineering strategy, roadmap and operating model.
* Establish scalable and reusable automation frameworks, engineering standards and quality practices across technology teams.
* Drive integration of automated testing and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous and reliable software delivery.
* Partner with engineering teams to identify opportunities to improve developer productivity, engineering effectiveness and SDLC efficiency.
* Promote adoption and maturity of modern DevOps and DevSecOps practices, including shift\-left quality and automation.
* Define and establish engineering metrics, KPIs and maturity measures that provide visibility into quality, productivity, delivery effectiveness and continuous improvement.
* Identify and implement opportunities for AI\-assisted engineering and intelligent automation across the software development lifecycle.
* Assess existing engineering practices and help teams establish standardized processes, workflows and continuous improvement mechanisms.
* Build reusable engineering capabilities, frameworks and patterns that can be adopted across multiple teams.
* Establish and facilitate Communities of Practice to promote engineering standards, knowledge sharing and adoption of best practices.
* Build, lead and mentor a high\-performing Engineering Excellence team.
* Partner across organizational boundaries and influence engineering leaders and teams to drive sustainable adoption and measurable improvement.

**Required Qualifications**

* 14\+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Quality Engineering, Test Automation, SDET or related engineering disciplines.
* Strong experience designing, implementing and scaling Test Automation / SDET / Quality Engineering capabilities.
* Demonstrated experience building reusable automation frameworks and engineering standards across multiple teams or products.
* Strong understanding of modern SDLC practices, CI/CD, DevOps and cloud\-native engineering.
* Experience integrating automated testing and quality controls into CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience leading technical teams and driving engineering transformation across organizational boundaries.
* Experience establishing or using engineering metrics, KPIs and maturity measures to drive continuous improvement.
* Strong stakeholder\-management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior engineering and technology leaders.
* Ability to translate complex engineering challenges into practical, scalable and measurable solutions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience establishing or leading an Engineering Excellence, Quality Engineering, Test Automation or Engineering Productivity capability.
* Exposure to DevSecOps, developer experience and platform engineering practices.
* Experience with engineering maturity assessments and continuous\-improvement frameworks.
* Practical experience applying Generative AI, AI\-assisted development/testing or intelligent automation within the SDLC.
* Experience establishing Communities of Practice or enterprise\-wide engineering standards.
* Experience working across globally distributed engineering organizations.
* Familiarity with modern cloud platforms, automation technologies and engineering toolchains.

**Leadership Expectations**

* The successful candidate will be a hands\-on engineering leader and capability builder who can operate across strategy and execution.
* They should be comfortable working with engineering teams at a technical level while also partnering with senior leaders to drive organizational change, establish standards and demonstrate measurable improvements.
* The role requires someone who can influence without relying solely on organizational authority, build credibility with engineering teams and progressively raise engineering maturity across the organization.

**Measures of Success**


Success in this role will be demonstrated through measurable improvements such as:

* Increased adoption and coverage of automated testing.
* Reduced regression and release\-validation effort.
* Improved integration of automated quality gates within CI/CD.
* Reduction in escaped defects and repeat quality issues.
* Improved engineering productivity and delivery effectiveness.
* Adoption of common engineering standards and reusable capabilities.
* Establishment of meaningful engineering metrics and maturity measures.
* Increased adoption of AI\-assisted engineering practices.
* Demonstrable improvement in engineering maturity across participating teams.
